description: Create a Markdown page in a space. The slug is derived from the title unless given. With a space-scoped token, omit "space" to use the token's space.

parent_page_id.description: Parent page UUID, to nest this page under another

slug.description: Explicit URL slug (auto-generated and deduped when omitted)

space.description: Space UUID or "workspaceSlug/spaceSlug" path. Optional for space-scoped tokens.

name: create_page
title: Create page
